summary: This Form 6-K reports a registered direct offering by Lifezone Metals Ltd, a foreign private issuer. The company issued 5,700,000 ordinary shares at $4.40 per share for gross proceeds of ~$25.08M. Roth Capital acted as sole placement agent with a 6% fee. Directors and officers agreed to a 30-day lock-up. Proceeds are for exploration, PGM recycling, and R&D. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
